link.title: Experience Live Runner Examples
link.description: Working runner examples you can open, interact with and pull apart. Reading about a runner only gets you so far - these are complete, live pages where a published Bitbybit script drives real geometry in a browser, with inputs wired up so you can change parameters and watch the model rebuild. They are a good reference for how the pieces fit together in practice: loading the runner, passing inputs in, receiving geometry back, and connecting it to the page around it. Use them as a starting point for your own integration.
